rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a military aircraft designed to carry and drop bombs.

example.english: This bomber can drop many bombs at once.
example.traditional: 呢架轟炸機可以一次過投落好多炸彈。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaa3 gwang1 zaa3 gei1 ho2 ji5 jat1 ci3 gwo3 tau4 lok6 hou2 do1 zaa3 daan2

rows.note: Use this for a person who plants or sets bombs, especially in a terrorist context.

example.english: The police said the bomber planted a bomb at the station.
example.traditional: 警方話嗰個炸彈客喺車站放咗炸彈。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 waa6 go2 go3 zaa3 daan6 haak3 hai2 ce1 zaam6 fong3 zo2 zaa3 daan6
